versions.changelog:
Initial release of auth0-fastify-api skill.

- Secure Fastify API endpoints using JWT Bearer token validation via @auth0/auth0-fastify-api.
- Supports permission checks, stateless authentication, and integration with REST APIs receiving Auth0-issued access tokens.
- Includes quick start setup, example code, troubleshooting tips, and references for protecting API routes.
- Describes when to use this skill and alternative options for web or mobile apps.
- Provides quick reference for plugin options, middleware usage, and common mistakes.
